chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: Fatima (peace be upon her) lived after her father for seventy-five days; she was not seen smiling nor laughing. She would visit the graves of the martyrs twice every Friday, on Monday and Thursday, and she would say: 'Over there was the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family); over there were the polytheists.'

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ): The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ ( عليها السلام ): Fatima (peace be upon her), daughter of the Prophet

ai.seo_question: How long did Fatima (peace be upon her) live after the Prophet's death and what was her state of grief?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi details the seventy-five-day mourning period of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) following the Prophet's death, emphasizing her profound, unceasing grief as she neither smiled nor laughed. It highlights her spiritual practice of visiting the graves of martyrs, where she identified the specific locations of the Prophet and the polytheists, reflecting the Shia tradition of connecting personal sorrow with the broader narrative of prophetic history and the Ahl al-Bayt's sacrifice.
